name: Pasta with meat sauce and vegetarian sauce + small salad
equipment: 2 pots for sauce (meat and veg, kept separate)
notes: Meat sauce uses ground turkey, not beef, so no-beef families are covered. It is not halal or kosher.
Vegetarian sauce is the planned main for vegetarian, halal and kosher eaters, plus ~25% of everyone else.
Separate ladles for each sauce; label the pots. Cook the veg sauce first.
Salad is intentionally small: pre-washed greens, one or two dressings.
Cooking staples: salt for the pasta water, oil for browning and tossing, Italian seasoning + garlic powder for both sauces.
Crew: AOL scouts help with salad, serving and cleanup; adults handle boiling water.
Storage: cool leftover sauce and pasta fast (shallow containers, into the cooler within 2 hours) or send it home; bag unused salad greens.

items._doc: pasta water, ~0.75 oz per lb pasta

roles: Water + pasta (2 adults): boiling water and draining are adults only
Sauces (1 adult): veg pot first, then meat pot
Salad + line (1 adult) + AOL scouts: salad bowls, serving parmesan and salad, cleanup

steps.text: Fill 2-3 large pots with water (about 5 quarts per pound of pasta, cooked in batches). Cover and bring to a boil; camp burners take 30-45 minutes.
Handwash station up. Wipe down prep tables. Dice {onion} for the meat sauce.
Set the sealed kosher meals aside on a separate, labeled tray. They are not opened or heated in our pots.
VEG SAUCE FIRST: in its own pot, warm about 40% of the marinara ({marinara} total) with Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Label the pot VEG and give it its own ladle.

MEAT SAUCE: brown the ground turkey ({ground_turkey}) in a little oil with the diced onion, salt and pepper until there's no pink (165°F). Drain, add the rest of the marinara plus seasoning, and simmer 15 minutes. Label the pot MEAT.
Salt the boiling water (about {salt} across all batches). Cook the pasta ({pasta}) in batches of about 2 lb per pot, 9-11 minutes. Drain, toss with a little oil, and hold covered.
Salad: greens ({salad_greens}) into bowls; dressing ({salad_dressing}) on the side. Parmesan ({parmesan}) in a bowl with a spoon.

serving: Line order: mess kits → pasta → VEG sauce → MEAT sauce → parmesan → salad. The veg sauce comes first so the meat ladle never touches it.
About 1 cup of pasta to start (1.5 for adults); seconds once everyone has gone through.
Keep both sauces on low heat, lids on.
food_safety: Ground turkey is cooked to 165°F with no pink.
Only adults handle boiling water and draining. Kids stay back from the burners.
Hot food stays hot; leftovers go into shallow containers and into the cooler within 2 hours.
cleanup: Let pasta water cool, strain out the food, and dispose of it per campground rules, away from water sources.
Scrape pots before washing. Sauce leftovers go home in containers; nothing is cooked Sunday.

diet.vegetarian: VEG sauce pot (own ladle) + pasta + salad.
diet.halal: VEG sauce pot + pasta + salad. The meat sauce is ground turkey that isn't halal-certified.
diet.kosher: Sealed kosher meal (shared pots aren't kosher). Hand it over unopened.
diet.gluten_free: Regular pasta has wheat. Cook a separate pot of GF pasta first, with its own colander.
diet.nut_free: No nuts on this menu; check the dressing and parmesan labels.
